ptc_pedestal_mixture_offset.unit: ADC counts (pedestal session 02 used, minus its near-state level)
ptc_pedestal_mixture_offset.note: ten bias frames per gain through stats.offset_state.  A mixture mean sits f_far*step above the near state, so this is f_far*step and not an error in the mean itself -- section 3 is why subtracting it alone would make g worse, not better

ptc_bias_occupancy.unit: fraction of frames far, session 02's bias groups
ptc_bias_occupancy.note: a third independent night at these settings.  Session 04 measured 0.333 at gain 0 and 0.250 at gain 450; notebook 10 backed 0.200 out of session 01's published pedestal

system_gain_restated.note: session 02's estimator on a signal axis with flats and bias reduced to the same state, on the rungs section 3 found readable against panel drift.  The uncertainty field is the spread between the bias-side-only and both-sides fits, which is what the drift-limited rungs leave open.  It does NOT supersede ptc_constants.json's system_gain: that is a record decision, not a notebook's

system_gain_move_pct.unit: percent change from session 02's published system_gain
system_gain_move_pct.note: what the state cost g at each gain.  Session 02's own fit residual is 1.344%, so a move below that is inside the noise the gain law already carries

state_step_at_gain100.note: stats.offset_state over session 01's 450-frame pedestal_drift block, out of sample in three ways: a different night, a different notebook, and a gain session 04 could not resolve (its limit there was 0.776 against a 0.488 prediction).  H2 predicts 0.4878, agreeing to +5.1%.  Measured with the published classifier and not with an edge-to-edge gap (D71)

state_explains_L31.note: L31 contrasts a 1.79% repeat spread at gain 100 with 0.011% at gain 200, a factor of 163.  H2's steps at those gains are 0.488 and 0.558 counts, a factor of 0.87: the mechanism predicts the two behave the same.  Independently, 1.79% of a linearity rung near 2000 counts is ~36 counts against a half-count state.  L31 stays queued with its mechanism unknown; what IS confirmed is the bimodality itself

dark_bound_limited_by.unit: one of: random hopping, exposure-correlated offset, statistics
dark_bound_limited_by.note: session 03 rejected 0 anomalous frames in every block and its 300 s blocks agree to 0.008 counts, so within-group hopping is refuted by its own published table.  What survives is an offset that tracks exposure length, which a peer-group rule cannot see because exposure is what defines a peer group

dark_current_conditional.unit: e-/px/s at -10 C, CONDITIONAL on the best integer-step assignment
dark_current_conditional.note: excess against exposure with each group allowed an integer number of H2 steps: the assignment (0, 0, 1, 1) linearises 14 blocks to 0.0161 counts rms, at the within-group noise floor.  It is NOT a replacement for dark_current_bound: slope, intercept and 3 relative integers against 4 exposure groups is under-determined.  The decisive test is a fifth and sixth exposure, which is a bench night
